notes.title: Rock Digger 0.5.6c - Patch Notes
notes.content:
Updated the build to add some features from the current dev build:

 - You now have access to a minimap, a special room detector, and a full map (press TAB or Select on gamepad, pan and zoom with mouse or sticks).

 - Updated some art, mainly the background art.

notes.title: Rock Digger 0.5.5
notes.content:
Added more special rooms (puzzles, minigames, ...) that can randomly appear in the second biome.

The second biome now has enough special rooms to generate them throughout its entire depth, preventing the bottom of the biome to only contain empty caves.
